title: The tarp, again
logline: The lawn chair under its tarp the day before Thanksgiving, and this year a second shape under a second tarp beside it: the stool. The page counts what's covered.

panels.composition: An old lawn chair and a shop stool side by side on a dock, each under a tied tarp, gray afternoon, the shack shut.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old lawn chair and a shop stool side by side on a wooden dock each under a tied tarp, gray afternoon, a shingle shack shut behind, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
